Against whom have you opened your mouth wide
Are you not sons of wickedness,
qui consolamini in diis subter omne lignum frondosum,
who are being consoled by idols under every leafy tree,
immolating little children at the torrents,
Your portion is in the currents of the torrent;
And you yourselves have poured out libations to them;
Should I not be angry over these things?
Upon a high and lofty mountain,
et illuc ascendisti ut immolares hostias.
and you have ascended to that place to immolate victims.
you have set up your memorial.
For you uncovered yourself next to me,
and you formed a pact with them.
You loved their bed with an open hand.
And you have adorned yourself for the king with ointments,
and you have increased your cosmetics.
You have sent your representatives to distant places,
et humiliata es usque ad inferos.
and you have debased yourself all the way to Hell.
You have been wearied by the multitude of your own ways.
You have found life by your own hand;
because of this, you have not prayed.
For whose sake have you been anxiously afraid,
so that you would lie and not be mindful of me,
nor consider me in your heart?
Quia ego tacens et quasi non videns,
and I am like someone who does not see,
and so you have forgotten me.
et opera tua non proderunt tibi.
and your works will not benefit you.
et omnes eos auferet ventus, tollet aura.
But the wind will carry them all away;
a breeze will take them up.
hæreditabit terram, et possidebit montem sanctum meum.
But he who has faith in me will inherit the earth and will possess my holy mountain.
Move to the side of the path!
auferte offendicula de via populi mei.
Take the obstacles out of the way of my people!”
For this is said by the Most High,
in excelso et in sancto habitans,
for he dwells in the exalted and holy place,
et cum contrito et humili spiritu:
and he acts with a restrained and humble spirit,
to revive the spirit of the humble,
and to revive the heart of the contrite.
For I will not contend unceasingly,
and I will not be angry to the end.
quia spiritus a facie mea egredietur,
For I will exhale my breath,
and the Spirit will go forth from my face.
Propter iniquitatem avaritiæ ejus iratus sum,
Because of the iniquity of his avarice, I was angry,
I concealed my face from you,
et indignatus sum; et abiit vagus in via cordis sui.
and I was angry. And he went astray by wandering in his heart.
and I led him back again,
and I restored consolations to him
and to those who mourn for him.
I created the fruit of the lips: peace,
pacem ei qui longe est et qui prope,
peace to him who is far away, and peace to him who is near,
But the impious are like the raging sea,
which is not able to be quieted,
et redundant fluctus ejus in conculcationem et lutum.
